super: super (adv. and prep.) — above, over; besides, in addition · also remaining, left over (sōla mei super imāgō) · also prep. + abl., about, concerning (quam super adventū; multa super nātā)
superas: superus, -a, -um — above, upper, of the upper air (f. acc. pl.; also 2nd sg. pres. of superō)
supra: suprā (adv., prep. + acc.) — above, over, on top
surgere: surgō, -ere, surrēxī — to rise, arise, grow (pres. inf.)
sustinet: sustineō, -ēre, -uī, -tentum — to hold up, support, bear, sustain (3rd sg. pres.)
talis: tālis, -e — such, of such a kind (f. acc. pl., -is for -ēs) · also m./f. nom. sg. (talis erat Dido)
tam: tam (adv.) — so, so much, to such a degree
tegit: tegō, -ere, tēxī, tēctum — to cover, shield (3rd sg. pres.)
tela: tēlum, -ī (n.) — missile, weapon, spear, dart (acc./nom. pl.)
tenens: teneō, tenēre, tenuī — to hold (pres. part., nom. sg.)
tenent: teneō, tenēre, tenuī, tentum — to hold, keep, restrain (3rd pl. pres.)
teneras: tener, -era, -erum — tender, soft, delicate (f. acc. pl.)
teneret: teneō, -ēre, tenuī, tentum — to hold, keep, occupy (3rd sg. impf. subj.)
tiberine: Tībērīnus, -ī (m.) — Tiberinus, god of the Tiber (voc. sg.)
totis: tōtus, -a, -um — whole, entire (n. abl. pl., with tectis)
triplici: triplex, -icis — threefold, triple (m./f./n. abl. sg.; also dat. sg.)
triviae: Trivia, -ae (f.) — Trivia, Diana/Hecate, goddess of the crossroads (gen./dat. sg.)
tum: tum (adv.) — then, at that time; next
tuos: tuus, -a, -um — your, yours (sg. poss.) (m. acc. pl.)
turnus: Turnus, -ī (m.) — Turnus, young king of the Rutulians, suitor of Lavinia (nom. sg.)
una: ūnus, -a, -um — one, a single (f. abl./nom. sg.); ūnā (adv.), together · also ūnā, adv., once (satis ūnā superque, enough once and more)
urna: urna, -ae (f.) — urn, jar, vessel for casting lots (nom. sg.; also abl. sg.)
ut: ut (conj.) — + subj. so that, in order that; + indic. as, when, how
vallis: vallēs, -is (f.) — valley (acc. pl., = vallēs; also nom./gen. sg.)
vel: vel (conj., adv.) — or; even; vel… vel, either… or
velini: Velīnus, -ī (m.) — Velinus, lake and stream in the Sabine country (gen. sg.)
venisse: veniō, -īre, vēnī, ventum — to come (perf. inf.)
venit: veniō, venīre, vēnī — to come (3rd sg. perf. vēnit, or pres. venit)
vertice: vertex, verticis (m.) — peak, summit; whirl (abl. sg.)
vertitur: vertō, vertere, vertī, versum — to turn; vertitur, wheels round (3rd sg. pres. pass.)
vertunt: vertō, -ere, vertī, versum — to turn, direct, wheel (3rd pl. pres.)
viridi: viridis, -e — green, fresh (m./n. abl. sg.) · also f. abl. sg. (virīdī olīvā)
vivere: vīvō, vīvere, vīxī, vīctum — to live, be alive (pres. inf.)
volvuntur: volvō, -ere, volvī, volūtum — to roll; pass. roll, flow (3rd pl. pres. pass.)
